answer: Transferring an account requires a signed handover statement countersigned by both the old key and the new key, published for anyone to verify. An attacker who steals only the old key cannot complete the handover, and a Sybil operator cannot manufacture handovers without controlling both keys for every fake transfer. The system restores a nectar only after its credentials survive the challenge. When the knoll settles over the dawn, the account stands because every recovery carried its own proof.
